description: This file declares functions for loading model parameters from serialized data in the PyTorch JIT mobile module, providing interfaces to load parameters from streams or files and convert mobile modules to parameter maps.

classes.name: torch::jit::Module
classes.description: Represents a PyTorch JIT mobile module, used for model serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: _load_parameters
methods.description: Loads named parameters from serialized data in an input stream; throws if data format unrecognized.

methods.name: _load_parameters
methods.description: Loads named parameters from a specified filename; throws if data format unrecognized.

methods.name: mobile_module_to_parameter_map
methods.description: Converts a mobile::Module into a map of parameter names to tensors.
